parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description:
The private IP address of the instance. The private IP address must be within the CIDR block of the vSwitch that is specified by the **VSwitchId** parameter.

>  You can call the DescribeVSwitches operation to query the CIDR block of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: VPCId
parameters.description:
The VPC ID.

> The VPC must reside in the same region as the instance.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The vSwitch ID of the instance.

> The vSwitch must belong to the same zone as the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds switch-db-instance-vpc --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --vpc-id vpc-uf6f7l4fg900000 --vswitch-id vsw-uf6adz52c2p0000 --private-ip-address 10.23.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
